excludeCloserTo.note: Majlis Sukan Negara Malaysia centroid (relation/8555772): unnamed roofs nearer MSN than the stadium stay unzoned

zoneNotes: Three building zones (the fourth overview zone, Bukit Jalil Recreational Park, is a green area, not blocks: OSM leisure=park 'Taman Rekreasi Bukit Jalil', way/104732875). (1) Pavilion Bukit Jalil = the OSM building 'Pavilion Bukit Jalil' (way/1010118636, building=retail) and parts inside it; (2) National Sports Complex = the named venues by OSM building name (Unifi Arena, ex-Axiata Arena; the National Squash Centre; Stadium Hoki Nasional; the National Sports Council HQ) plus the building=roof pieces within 460 m of the National Stadium centre (OSM leisure=stadium 'TM Stadium Nasional', way/24691651, has no building tag: its roof and the aquatic centre canopies are mapped as unnamed building=roof pieces), except roofs closer to MSN HQ than to the stadium (east unlabelled MSN strip stays context-coloured); (3) Bukit Jalil City = remaining blocks in the OSM landuse=commercial polygon 'Bukit Jalil City' (way/516568203). Priority decides which rule wins.
railLineNotes: The Sri Petaling Line (Line 4, OSM name 'Sri Petaling Line') is the only rail line in this area; it is stored as the area's 'lrt' line so the model draws its viaduct and trains in the LRT slot (a website passes the Line 4 colour as palette.rail.lrt).
landmarkNotes: Selected by OSM name. The National Stadium (OSM leisure=stadium 'TM Stadium Nasional', way/24691651) has no building tag; its roof is mapped as ~300 building=roof pieces, which the model draws as blocks (estimated heights), so it is not a landmark entry here.

anchors.label: National Stadium
anchors.pointNote: centre of the OSM leisure=stadium outline 'TM Stadium Nasional' (way/24691651, mean of its 74 nodes, OSM API 2026-10-12)

anchorNotes: STADIUM is a point (the stadium has no building outline in OSM). Routes snap to the nearest mapped pedestrian node (≤ 25 m warning in the log).
routeNotes: routes (Connections): Bukit Jalil LRT to the National Stadium and to Axiata Arena (the sports complex walks), and Awan Besar LRT, the nearest station, to Pavilion Bukit Jalil (the mall walk).
modelNotes: The Sri Petaling Line runs on a viaduct here; trains stop at Bukit Jalil (SP17), next to the stadium.
